purpose: Manual regression gate for the LoRA tuning track. A FAILURE gate only - it can disqualify a tuned candidate, it can never be cited as evidence that tuning worked (FINETUNING.md 2).

selection.method: selectPairwiseSubset(handbuilt-ext, 20) - stratified by slice x direction, 5 per stratum, lowest id first within each stratum
selection.note: Frozen here as an explicit id list so a later change to selectPairwiseSubset, or to the dataset, cannot silently move the gate. datasets/v1/manual-regression-20.test.js fails if it does.

baseline.note: The outputs recorded below are runIndex 0 of this run - the no-think product baseline the tuned candidate must not regress against.

criteria.meaningDistortion: Does the output state something the source does not, or drop something the source does? Obvious distortion only - a debatable register choice is not a failure here.
criteria.hanjaLeak: Any Hanja/Chinese character in a Korean-written field (nuance, tip, alternative labels, and natural/literal when direction is en_to_ko).
criteria.verdict: pass | fail | null. null means not yet reviewed. Fill these in BEFORE any tuned candidate output is generated or inspected; a verdict recorded after seeing the candidate is not a control.
criteria.scope: Judge the fields that present a translation: natural, literal, and the alternatives' expressions. nuance and tip are scored separately by the LLM judge (nuanceGrounded, tipFactual) and a weak one is not a failure here - but a nuance that repeats and confirms an error in natural is cited as evidence that the error is systematic, not a slip. The tuned candidate must be judged under exactly this scope.

review_pass.independence_caveat: This gate exists as the check that is NOT an LLM judge, and it was filled by an LLM. The verdicts are therefore not independent of the claude-sonnet-5 absolute/pairwise judge - same vendor, likely correlated blind spots. Treat them as a pre-registered, written-down standard rather than as a human control, and have a person re-read at least the failures before any tuning claim rests on this file.
review_pass.note: Recorded while no tuned candidate exists (Phase 5 has not run), so these verdicts cannot have been shaped by the candidate.
review_pass.gate: FAILURE gate. A tuned candidate fails if it distorts meaning or leaks Hanja on any item the baseline passed. Fixing baseline failures is not evidence of success - that is what the pairwise sign test on all 40 items is for (FINETUNING.md 2).
